name: aiflowbridge
displayName: AIFlowBridge - 100+ AI models via OpenRouter, plus DeepSeek V4, MiniMax M3 & MiMo in Copilot Chat
description: 100+ AI models through one free local gateway. OpenRouter (GPT-5.6, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Llama 4 Maverick, MiniMax M3, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Qwen 3.7 Max) reaches GitHub Copilot Chat, Kilo Code, Continue, Open WebUI, and JetBrains AI Assistant through a unified OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1. Three direct vendors (DeepSeek V4 at $0.27/M in, MiniMax M3 at $0.30/M in, Xiaomi MiMo V2 at $0.10/M in) keep the door open for the cheapest direct path. 4 problems solved: (1) one OpenRouter key unlocks 100+ models behind a single endpoint, (2) three direct vendor keys for the lowest per-token cost when needed, (3) free vision for text-only models via a transparent proxy to your Copilot-bundled vision model, (4) live metrics dashboard with per-request token counts, latency, estimated cost, refreshed pricing snapshots from OpenRouter, and pair-programming session replay + CSV/JSON export of the filtered telemetry. Free, open-source, ad-free, no data collection. Pay only the upstream providers you use.

aiflowbridge.gateway.enabled.description: Start the local gateway automatically on extension activation

aiflowbridge.gateway.port.description: Local port exposed by the gateway

aiflowbridge.gateway.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL exposed to AI clients

aiflowbridge.gateway.defaultModel.description: Default logical model name when the client does not specify one

aiflowbridge.gateway.probeTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for probing a peer gateway's /version endpoint on port conflict. Higher values tolerate slower peer startups; lower values fail fast on a foreign service.

aiflowbridge.gateway.maxConcurrentReques.description: Maximum number of upstream /v1/chat/completions requests in flight. Requests above the limit return HTTP 429. Protects the upstream from a runaway local client.

aiflowbridge.gateway.maxConcurrentPerPro.description: Per-upstream-provider cap on concurrent in-flight requests. The gateway queues additional requests for the same provider behind this cap instead of opening more parallel sockets to the same upstream. Set to 0 to disable.

aiflowbridge.gateway.upstreamIdleTimeout.description: Idle timeout (ms) for the upstream fetch. If no bytes arrive for this many ms, the gateway aborts and returns HTTP 504. Caps the 'agent in standby for minutes' symptom when an upstream silently queues a thinking-mode request. Set to 0 to disable.

aiflowbridge.gateway.streamTotalTimeoutM.description: Hard ceiling (ms) on total upstream call duration. Even if bytes keep flowing, the gateway aborts and returns HTTP 504 after this many ms. Bounded safety net for the idle watchdog. Set to 0 to disable.

aiflowbridge.gateway.minimaxParallelToke.description: Fire the parallel /v1/responses/input_tokens pre-count on every MiniMax request (including streaming). Default false: skip on streaming because the MiniMax stream emits usage on the final chunk and the parallel pre-count doubles upstream load precisely when thinking-mode bursts hurt the most.

aiflowbridge.gateway.bufferGeminiStream.description: Buffer the full Gemini / Antigravity upstream SSE body before reshaping it into OpenAI frames (drain then transform). Default false: real-time pipeThrough streaming with the best TTFT. Set to true on lossy links where the buffered replay is more robust.

aiflowbridge.gateway.workspaceContext.en.description: Prepend a short system-message describing the workspace languages / package managers / linters / formatters detected at the configured root. Set to false for non-code workspaces or to opt out per-request. Action plan item #2.

aiflowbridge.gateway.workspaceContext.ro.description: Absolute path to the workspace root to scan. Empty -> fall back to the AIFLOWBRIDGE_WORKSPACE env var, then to the VS Code workspace folder. Detection skips any missing path so an empty value is a no-op.

aiflowbridge.gateway.workspaceContext.ma.description: Max directory depth the workspace-context detector walks (root = 0). Default 2 covers typical monorepo layouts without scanning deep dependency trees.

aiflowbridge.gateway.workspaceContext.ig.description: Directory names the workspace-context detector skips entirely (no recursion, no listing). The defaults cover the standard build / VCS / dependency directories for all three supported vendor families.

aiflowbridge.gateway.languageRouting.description: Per-language provider routing map. Keys are language identifiers (python / rust / go / typescript / cpp / ...). Values are provider ids matched against the configured `aiflowbridge.providers[].id` (the same id resolution as the existing model picker). The wildcard key '*' is the fallback for any language not explicitly mapped. Action plan item #5. Example: { "python": "deepseek-flash", "rust": "deepseek-pro", "*": "minimax" }.

additionalProperties.description: Provider id (e.g. deepseek-flash, deepseek-pro, MiniMax-M3, miniMax, xiaomi).

aiflowbridge.gateway.allowLanguageHeader.description: Whether the explicit `X-AIFlowBridge-Language` HTTP request header can pin the per-language routing decision. Default `true` for backward compatibility with loopback clients. Set to `false` on hardened / shared machines so peers can never force a provider via this header - the routing hint is then sourced only from the request body and the workspace context.

aiflowbridge.gateway.events.maxConnectio.description: Maximum number of simultaneous `GET /v1/events` SSE connections. New connections above the cap receive HTTP 429 + `Retry-After`. Set to `0` to disable. Default 16

aiflowbridge.gateway.events.maxLifetimeM.description: Maximum wall-clock lifetime (ms) of an SSE connection before the gateway closes it cleanly so the client reconnects. Set to `0` to disable. Default 1800000 (30 minutes).

aiflowbridge.gateway.events.includeSumma.description: Whether `request.recorded` SSE events carry the `promptSummary` / `responseSummary` fields. Default `false` (audit-recommended): a passive SSE listener never sees prompt or response text in real time. The `GET /v1/replay/{id}` endpoint stays the explicit, opt-in way to fetch the captured summaries.

aiflowbridge.gateway.discovery.enabled.description: Enable the zero-conf UDP discovery beacon + GET /v1/discovery HTTP endpoint. Default false (no LAN broadcast). Action plan item #4.

aiflowbridge.gateway.discovery.broadcast.description: UDP destination port for the discovery beacon. Default 8788. Listeners on the same network pick the gateway up on this port.
Discovery beacon emission interval (ms). Default 2000 (every 2 s).

aiflowbridge.providers.description: Logical upstream provider profiles routed by the proxy

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the upstream provider

enabled.description: Enable or disable this provider profile

billing.description: Billing mode: 'token' for per-token upstream billing (real charge), 'plan' when usage is covered by a token plan / subscription / OAuth plan (MiniMax token plan, Google AI plan) - the Est. cost stays indicative and is marked plan-covered in the dashboard

aiflowbridge.providers.deepseek.modelIdO.description: Model ID overrides for DeepSeek models

aiflowbridge.providers.minimax.modelIdOv.description: Model ID overrides for MiniMax models

aiflowbridge.providers.minimax.topP.description: Nucleus sampling parameter for MiniMax requests

aiflowbridge.providers.minimax.reasoning.description: Enable reasoning split streaming for MiniMax

aiflowbridge.providers.xiaomi.modelIdOve.description: Model ID overrides for Xiaomi MiMo models

aiflowbridge.providers.xiaomi.reasoningR.description: Replay reasoning_content in tool-call followups to satisfy MiMo API requirements

aiflowbridge.providers.openrouter.baseUr.description: OpenRouter API base URL (100+ models via single OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

aiflowbridge.providers.googleaistudio.ba.description: Google AI Studio (Gemini) API base URL for the BYOK API-key route. OAuth / Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist uses a separate path - see docs/providers.md. The default targets the public Gemini API (not the Antigravity OAuth endpoint).

aiflowbridge.providers.googleaistudio.ap.description: Google AI Studio (Gemini) API key for the BYOK route. Create one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Distinct from the Antigravity OAuth tokens (which live in secrets.json under the antigravity key).

aiflowbridge.telemetry.logRequests.description: Log each request handled by the gateway

aiflowbridge.telemetry.captureSessionLog.description: Capture sanitized + truncated prompt / response summaries on every recorded request so the Shared Session panel + GET /v1/sessions + GET /v1/replay/{id} + GET /v1/events can replay them. Disable to keep the on-disk telemetry file lean. Action plan item #3.

aiflowbridge.telemetry.maxStoredRequestB.description: Hard byte cap on the serialized size of a single persisted telemetry entry (promptSummary + responseSummary inclusive). Entries larger than this have their summaries truncated before being appended to on-disk telemetry. Default 8192 (8 KiB). Set to 0 to disable the cap.

aiflowbridge.telemetry.retentionDays.description: Retention window (days) for the on-disk telemetry snapshot. Entries older than this are pruned on every read and write. Default 90. Set to 0 to disable retention entirely (keep every entry forever).

aiflowbridge.vision.excludedVendors.description: Vendors that should NOT use the vision proxy

aiflowbridge.vision.copilotVisionModel.description: Model to use for vision proxy in GitHub Copilot

aiflowbridge.userModels.description: User-defined models merged with built-in models. Each entry follows the ModelDefinition shape (id, name, family, version, detail, maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens, capabilities, requiresThinkingParam).

id.description: Unique model ID (must match what the upstream API expects)

name.description: Display name shown in the Copilot Chat model picker

detail.description: Short description (fallback: built-in detail for the same family)

requiresThinkingParam.description: Whether the upstream requires an explicit thinking param

aiflowbridge.vision.prompt.default:
Describe all image attachments in this message.

If there is one image, describe it directly.
If there are multiple images:
1. Describe each image separately, preserving their order.
2. Then provide a combined description explaining the overall context.

Return one concise factual description suitable for inserting into a text-only chat prompt.
aiflowbridge.vision.prompt.description: Prompt used for vision proxy image descriptions

scripts.clean:standalone: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/standalone', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/aiflowbridge', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/logger.js', { force: true })" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/config.js', { force: true })" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/consts.js', { force: true })" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/types.js', { force: true })" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/json.js', { force: true })"
scripts.compile:standalone: npm run clean:standalone && tsc -p tsconfig.standalone.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.standalone.json && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/standalone/main.js', 0o755)" && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const s=fs.statSync('dist/standalone/main.js');console.log('[build:standalone] OK - dist/standalone/main.js (' + s.size + ' bytes)')"
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm test && npm run typecheck:tests && vsce package -o dist/
scripts.publish:vscode: npm run compile && npm test && vsce publish
scripts.publish:openvsx: npm run compile && npm test && ovsx publish
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:vscode && npm run publish:openvsx
